description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to the property of intestate in Muddaragama, Mirigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510205 and to 06 other properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically notices calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions including village names, cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers. The content focuses on property registration and land title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
